notes: 1.3.43: the app window. Episode Factory opens as its own window - no browser, no console - with its own icon, from a shortcut INSTALL.bat puts on your desktop and in the Start menu, like any installed program. Closing the window closes the page; a run that is going keeps going. The window is drawn by Windows' own web view through one small library INSTALL.bat adds to the product's environment; when it cannot be added the page opens in your browser as before. Also in this line: the picture judge (1.3.34), an update keeping your settings (1.3.35), the judge by the card (1.3.38), the full Pixabay category table (1.3.41), space as a topic (1.3.42).
